scientific_integrity: Analytical Banach fixed-point existence and Schur stability are checked by standalone exact rational interval arithmetic; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The claim proves at least four hyperbolic attractors at a specified rational coupling and locally nearby values, not a global attractor census or an optimal parameter interval. title: Certified coexistence of twisted sinks and attracting travelling three-cycles in a discrete Huygens triangle
